description: A rain-slicked, grey city avenue lined with bare winter trees and lamp posts, with barricades along both sides. Cardboard placards bearing black peace symbols lean against a black lamp post in the foreground, with wooden sticks and scattered paper and debris on the wet asphalt. A black sedan with its lights on drives on the right, and a few more cars recede into the mist. No people are visible; the mood is bleak and overcast, in a loose painterly style.
